knowledge.name: Bundled synthetic lead snapshot
knowledge.detail: Fixed lead, firmographic, technology, intent, engagement, territory, capacity, and SLA evidence; no live lookup.

knowledge.name: ICP and BANT qualification rules
knowledge.detail: Documented weights, thresholds, field mappings, tier labels, ordering, and rounding drive repeatable qualification.

knowledge.name: Sales routing and SLA policies
knowledge.detail: Synthetic AE specialties, territories, capacity, response windows, escalation rules, and sequence plans support review.

knowledge.name: Operating and evidence boundaries
knowledge.detail: Knowledge files require synthetic-only answers, missing-field disclosure, assumption labels, and authorized review.

intelligence_processing.name: ICP scoring and lead tiering
intelligence_processing.detail: Scores size, industry, technology fit, budget, and authority, then classifies leads into four documented tiers.

intelligence_processing.name: BANT evidence assessment
intelligence_processing.detail: Breaks down budget, authority, need, and timeline evidence and surfaces missing or weak qualification fields.

intelligence_processing.name: Personalized outreach drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds reviewable subjects, hooks, calls to action, and cadence ideas from synthetic lead context without sending.

intelligence_processing.name: Lead routing recommendation
intelligence_processing.detail: Matches actionable leads to synthetic AE specialty and capacity data; recommendations never assign CRM ownership.

intelligence_processing.name: SLA and escalation planning
intelligence_processing.detail: Drafts tier-based response windows, monitoring, and escalation rules without creating alerts, tasks, or automation.

intelligence_processing.name: Qualification scenario reporting
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes tier, industry, pipeline, and conversion scenarios while labeling all values as synthetic assumptions.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable RAPP Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: The single-file portable agent installs into Brainstem and exposes its allow-listed operations through chat.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio draft workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: CLI-authored skills and knowledge provide a seller-facing draft experience that remains unpublished by default.

clients_user_interface.name: Persona-guided review flows
clients_user_interface.detail: Locked prompts cover sales manager, business development representative, and account executive review scenarios.

management_reporting.name: Lead qualification summary
management_reporting.detail: Reports tier counts, average scores, top synthetic leads, and documented review actions with evidence boundaries.

management_reporting.name: BANT and engagement review
management_reporting.detail: Shows dimension scores, strongest recorded signals, and qualification gaps for sales-team review.

management_reporting.name: Routing and SLA review packs
management_reporting.detail: Presents capacity-aware routing, handoff contents, response windows, and draft escalation plans for manager approval.

management_reporting.name: Pipeline assumption report
management_reporting.detail: Summarizes synthetic pipeline and modeled conversions without treating scenarios as forecasts, commitments, or outcomes.

tools.name: SalesQualificationAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Portable Python tool with deterministic dispatch, synthetic-only source validation, and six allow-listed operations.

tools.name: Bundled knowledge files
tools.detail: Synthetic records and operating rules provide the complete evidence route for local and Copilot Studio use.

tools.name: Copilot Studio operation skills
tools.detail: Six uploadable skills mirror scoring, BANT, outreach drafting, routing, SLA planning, and reporting operations.

tools.name: PAC CLI authoring workflow
tools.detail: Initializes, validates, pulls, and pushes the draft package; publication remains a separate approved command.

tools.name: Deployment recipe and smoke test
tools.detail: Pins the portable source, expected tool, synthetic route, operation inventory, and required response evidence.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The host selects the supported model; deterministic agent calculations and evidence boundaries remain authoritative.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only fail-closed routing
supporting_features.detail: Unknown operations, sources, filters, or identifiers are rejected instead of triggering browsing or live-system access.

supporting_features.name: Human approval gates
supporting_features.detail: Managers retain control over qualification, routing, ownership, SLA rules, outreach content, and customer contact.

supporting_features.name: Review-only action boundary
supporting_features.detail: The agent never writes CRM data, assigns owners, sends outreach, activates sequences, creates alerts, or publishes.

supporting_features.name: Locked evidence validation
supporting_features.detail: Six persona cases verify required response anchors and prohibit claims that messages or CRM updates occurred.

supporting_features.name: Portable RAPP packaging
supporting_features.detail: The same credential-free synthetic agent runs locally and can seed a Copilot Studio package without live connectors.

supporting_features.name: Draft and publish separation
supporting_features.detail: Copilot Studio artifacts remain in Draft; push and validation do not authorize publication or external actions.
